text:
Ravi: quick pulse  planning a "shadow" onboarding wave for SIs who can't attend live training. Goal: kit-forward + async mentor pairing + badge issuance path. Need decisions by Fri.

Celeste: Love it. Key asks: how long is the shadow access window? And do we require a live check-in or just screencast evidence?

Ravi: Proposal: 14-day shadow window after kit receipt. Require a 2-minute screencast of bring-up + MC quiz. Offer optional 30-min live office hours for spot-checks.

Marcos: Logistics: if we ship kits for shadow cohort, mark boxes "Shadow Cohort" and include an extra return envelope to speed RMA. Also need ECCN on international docs.

Ava: Marketplace/marketing note: partners want a single-line blurb approving use of their name for the shadow program. Legal wants drafts 5 business days before any external mention.

Ravi: Tech snippet for the quickstart card (put this on the USB image README):

```bash
# shadow quickstart
redwoodctl kit attach --id $KIT_ID --role shadow
redwoodctl bringup --verify --timeout 300
# capture short screencast: 120s max
```

Marcos: Carrier prefs: FedEx NA/EU, DHL APAC. I'll request pickup once addresses are final. PO: RDW-SI-SHADOW-2987.

Celeste: For badges: issue provisional badge on quiz pass; final badge after screencast verified or 7 days post-ship. Add QR that links to validation page.

ops-bot: [automation] shadow-pack job queued (job_id=shadow-2987)  est pickup 2026-12-01.

Ravi: Action items:
- Marcos: compile manifests + PO (due Thu).
- Celeste: draft badge text + verification URL (due Thu).
- Ava: gather partner blurbs, copy to legal if embargoed (due Wed).

Marcos: one blocker: LATAM partner needs 110V adapter. Flagging now.

Ravi: noted, add exceptions here. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
